svg.title: Spatial registration workflow — method schematic, validation in progress
svg.desc: Editable schematic, not experimental measurements. Matched point-cloud and tactile landmarks are linked through calibrated gel geometry and independently calibrated rigid transformations. Held-out landmarks provide validation residuals.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
g.text: Method schematic · 方法示意（验证中）
Rigid pose transform · 刚体位姿变换
Pose and plate motion accounted for
Mapped tactile point / 触觉映射点
Optional: fixed pose/load + reference pixel | 可选：固定姿态/载荷＋参考像素
Schematic geometry only; no measured alignment accuracy is depicted. 几何均为示意，不代表实测对齐精度。
